hero.title: Inspiring the Next Generation Through Music
hero.subtitle: Our musicians visit local high schools to coach student orchestras, share repertoire, and remind them that a life with music — alongside any career — is possible.

image.alt: Redmond Tech Orchestra musicians coaching high school student musicians during a rehearsal

tagline: Investing in today's students. Strengthening tomorrow's community.
intro: Redmond Tech Orchestra is more than a place for working musicians to keep performing — it is a bridge between professional players and the next generation of young string and wind musicians across the Eastside.

Through high-school visits, sectional coaching, and side-by-side rehearsals, our members donate their time so that students can hear their parts played up close, ask questions, and see firsthand what years of practice make possible.

testimonial.quote: Thank you, Redmond Tech Orchestra, for taking the time to work with our students. Your encouragement and expertise make such a difference!
testimonial.author: Orchestra Director

cta.heading: Looking for music for your program or community?
cta.body: We partner with high-school orchestra programs across the Eastside for sectional coaching, side-by-side rehearsals, and Q&A clinics. If you direct a school program — or know one that could benefit — we'd love to hear from you.
